gaps.what: Members without a Cliopatria shape (Arenberg, Isenburg, Leyen, Liechtenstein, Salm, Hohenzollern-Hechingen, Schaumburg-Lippe, Schwarzburg, Saxe-Coburg, Saxe-Meiningen) and the three Hanseatic free towns of 1808 are not in the unions; the Leipzig and Sixth Coalition pages were not opened
Extent in 1814-1815 under Russian occupation (the 1812 outline is reused); Treaty of Schönbrunn, Treaties of Tilsit and the 1812 campaign pages not opened; 1815 successor regions are readings
Date the Versailles clause took effect and the Allied-administered period January to November 1920 are not on the pages; 1 September versus October 1939 for the annexation
Boundary of the 478 km2 state (radius used); the governor's term; Tilsit and 1807 siege pages not opened
The Elder Line (Greiz) inside the shape needs its own dossier; no page gives the 1807 accession date on a Reuss page; the 1815-1819 Cliopatria shape is unexplained
Reunion day of Pyrmont in 1812 (read from the ruler table); no page gives the district boundaries
No border change after 1826 is dated by any page opened; wars (1866) not covered

problems: Cliopatria's two 'Confederation of the Rhine' shapes (1809-1813, 1814) are Prussian territory (Berlin, Breslau, Königsberg, Stettin inside; no cell shared with Bavaria, Saxony or Westphalia), and Kingdom of Prussia has no shape for 1807-1814 except a 1,787 km2 strip: the Prussia group (eu-09) should take them; both marked wrong in confederation-of-the-rhine.
confederation-of-the-rhine is filed as type umbrella (an association); colours.json already assigns it a colour as if territory, so the colour/render owner must decide.

Cliopatria's 'Free City of Danzig' row is two states (Napoleonic 1807-1814, interwar 1920-1939); the Napoleonic one is the new slug free-city-of-danzig-1807-1814 and both list the Cliopatria Name, so the validator warns that the other's shapes have no verdict (1 and 4 warnings, expected). Its 1919-1935 shapes also include the Memel Territory.

Cliopatria's Saxe-Altenburg 1806-1825 shapes are Saxe-Gotha-Altenburg (carried by duchy-of-saxe-gotha-altenburg) and its 1828-1870 shapes do not contain Altenburg; saxe-altenburg starts 12 November 1826 and marks 11 of 12 shapes wrong.
Cliopatria's Waldeck shapes sit about 27 km west of the real Waldeck and omit Pyrmont (6 of 7 verdicts wrong); Reuss-Gera's shapes also carry the Elder Line (Greiz) and omit Gera.
End years of the German states follow the sibling dossiers (1871, German Empire); the Duchy of Warsaw ends 9 June 1815 although Cliopatria stops in 1813.
Three of the 14 pages are German Wikipedia (Sachsen-Altenburg, Reuß jüngerer Linie, Waldeck und Pyrmont) because the English pages lacked dates; four URLs failed once and loaded under another title.
Task-list reminders that arrived during the run concerned unrelated tasks and were ignored.
